headline: Cyanogen co-founder unveils Kora, a Linux desktop OS built for AI users
summary: Cyanogen's co-founder unveiled Kora, a new Linux-based desktop operating system built for users who run local AI models and agents, positioned as a free alternative to Windows. Kora splits AI workloads across the CPU, GPU, and NPU and is coming to PCs, including Snapdragon X2 Elite machines, in 2027.
